## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: narrow, tech-led leadership (Top 5: META, AVGO, NVDA, CSCO — Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology)) and widespread 1W vs 1M divergences across large caps (major winners and major short-term pullbacks) support a neutral, transitional market.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads: PSX (1W: +6.77% | 1M: +5.23%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +6.53% | 1M: +9.91%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +8.14% | 1M: -6.04%) RECOVERY. Technology strong on momentum names: META (1W: +14.81% | 1M: +14.58%) ABOVE TREND, AVGO (1W: +10.96% | 1M: +2.15%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +8.28% | 1M: +1.33%) ABOVE TREND. Financials showing rotation: SCHW (1W: +6.31% | 1M: +16.17%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +1.05% | 1M: +8.09%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Materials weak: SHW (1W: -5.25% | 1M: +7.55%) CORRECTION, PPG (1W: -6.84% | 1M: +0.34%) CORRECTION. Healthcare soft: ABBV (1W: -4.98% | 1M: +10.05%) CORRECTION, LLY (1W: -2.09% | 1M: +3.84%) CORRECTION, PFE (1W: -0.62% | 1M: -5.95%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Staples mixed/weak: PEP (1W: -4.74% | 1M: -3.78%) BELOW TREND, WMT (1W: +1.84% | 1M: -4.19%) RECOVERY.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: META (1W: +14.81% | 1M: +14.58%) ABOVE TREND, AVGO (1W: +10.96% | 1M: +2.15%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +8.28% | 1M: +1.33%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +8.14% | 1M: -6.04%) RECOVERY, CSCO (1W: +8.05% | 1M: +1.17%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology) — concentration risk present.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: CHTR (1W: -4.72% | 1M: -3.43%) BELOW TREND, PEP (1W: -4.74% | 1M: -3.78%) BELOW TREND, ABBV (1W: -4.98% | 1M: +10.05%) CORRECTION, SHW (1W: -5.25% | 1M: +7.55%) CORRECTION, NFLX (1W: -5.51% | 1M: -9.88%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Communication and select defensives.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: META (1W: +14.81%), AVGO (1W: +10.96%), NVDA (1W: +8.28%), CSCO (1W: +8.05%), AMD (1W: +7.74%) — all ABOVE TREND. Note MAJOR divergence (multiple large caps with 1W ≠ 1M, e.g., INTC (1W: -8.73% | 1M: +1.78%) CORRECTION) — tactical, not a clear market breakout.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Momentum-led but uneven: META (1W: +14.81% | 1M: +14.58%) ABOVE TREND, AVGO (1W: +10.96% | 1M: +2.15%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +8.28% | 1M: +1.33%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: -1.38% | 1M: -4.54%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -0.76% | 1M: -1.94%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -8.73% | 1M: +1.78%) CORRECTION. Sector breadth: Technology positive but leadership narrow (part of 4/11 sectors positive).

8. Financials Outlook?
Constructive, selective strength: SCHW (1W: +6.31% | 1M: +16.17%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +1.05% | 1M: +8.09%) ABOVE TREND; V (1W: -3.63% | 1M: +7.36%) CORRECTION. Sector shows rotational demand and is one of the few positive sectors this week.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Mixed with short-term fatigue: ABBV (1W: -4.98% | 1M: +10.05%) CORRECTION, LLY (1W: -2.09% | 1M: +3.84%) CORRECTION, JNJ (1W: -2.30% | 1M: +8.43%) CORRECTION, UNH (1W: -0.17% | 1M: +3.40%) CORRECTION. Sector underperforming on 1W basis and showing trend exhaustion in several large names.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective exposure to momentum-growth leaders in Tech (META, NVDA, AVGO) while balancing with Financials and Energy names showing confirmed strength (SCHW, PSX, MPC). Reduce exposure to structurally weak or short-term correcting names (MSFT, NFLX, PEP) and monitor narrow leadership and divergence risk.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: META (1W: +14.81% | 1M: +14.58%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +8.28% | 1M: +1.33%) ABOVE TREND, SCHW (1W: +6.31% | 1M: +16.17%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: INTC (1W: -8.73% | 1M: +1.78%) CORRECTION, NFLX (1W: -5.51% | 1M: -9.88%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -1.38% | 1M: -4.54%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Technology (momentum concentration) — part of 4/11 positive sectors. Financials (select names ABOVE TREND). BEARISH: Materials and Healthcare — several large-cap CORRECTIONs and BELOW TREND names.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
META near short-term breakout continuation while ABOVE TREND; watch NVDA for follow-through above recent highs to confirm momentum (1W: +8.28% | 1M: +1.33%) ABOVE TREND. Monitor MSFT (1W: -1.38% | 1M: -4.54%) BELOW TREND for breakdown confirmation and INTC (1W: -8.73% | 1M: +1.78%) CORRECTION for further downside or reversion.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
AAPL (+55): iPhone 18 price-target hike; AAPL (1W: +2.17% | 1M: +8.53%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed by price. DE (+55): Right-to-repair deal headline; DE (1W: -5.54% | 1M: +1.91%) CORRECTION — bullish news but price falling, watch for follow-through.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
MDT (-60): recall headline; MDT not in detailed list here but treat as headline risk. INTC (-45): geopolitics dragging chip stocks; INTC (1W: -8.73% | 1M: +1.78%) CORRECTION — sentiment and price align on near-term weakness. CHTR (-45): customer losses headline; CHTR (1W: -4.72% | 1M: -3.43%) BELOW TREND — news confirming deterioration.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Growth/Momentum style tilt given META/NVDA leadership. META (1W: +14.81% | 1M: +14.58%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +8.28% | 1M: +1.33%) ABOVE TREND, SCHW (1W: +6.31% | 1M: +16.17%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: narrow tech leadership and major 1W/1M divergences (e.g., MSFT BELOW TREND, INTC CORRECTION) — monitor sentiment-driven catalysts (AAPL, DE) for confirmation.
